opening.argument: The compensation structure pays for referrals, team growth, and purchases across a weaker side of the network. The speaker says, “you make money from direct sales which means that if you were refer somebody,” and describes a $500 bonus when someone on that side buys a package. The pitch also presents purchased coins as multiplying: “your account will split and your coins will go from 12,000 to 24,000,” with a further projection that each coin “could be anywhere worth 50 dollars up to a 100 dollar per coin.” It closes by urging viewers to “partner with our team today.” Together, recruitment commissions, tiered network incentives, speculative appreciation claims, and a direct call to join make recruitment and promised growth central to the video's persuasive message.
